attributes.name: ypy-stream
attributes.description: Opens a stream of the YPY streaming protocol (Server-Sent Events) with a GET request to the URL and applies its events: `ypy-patch-elements`, `ypy-patch-signals`, `ypy-redirect` and `ypy-event`. Opens on `load` or on the element's `ypy-trigger`; reconnects with backoff, `Last-Event-ID` and the current signals.

attributes.name: ypy-stream.post
attributes.description: Like `ypy-stream`, with a POST request that carries the element's values.

events.name: ypy:stream:open
events.description: A connection delivered its headers and is being read, the first time or after a reconnection.

events.name: ypy:stream:reconnect
events.description: The client is about to wait `detail.delay` ms before the next connection attempt.

events.name: ypy:stream:close
events.description: The stream ended for good. `detail.reason` is `api`, `removed`, `redirect`, `replaced`, `status <code>` or `error`.

events.name: ypy:stream:error
events.description: An event failed, or the read broke; after a read error the client reconnects.

events.name: ypy:stream:signals
events.description: A signals patch arrived and the signals extension is not loaded, so the page can apply it itself.

events.name: ypy:stream:refresh
events.description: A `ypy-refresh` event is about to make its request, after its debounce and jitter. `detail.selector` is the selector of the event, empty for the page. Cancel it to skip that refresh.

events.name: ypy:stream:pause
events.description: The tab went to the background and the stream, which has `pauseOnBackground`, closed its connection. It opens another one when the tab is visible again.

events.name: ypy:stream:resume
events.description: The tab is visible again and the stream that was paused opens its connection now, with `Last-Event-ID`.

config.name: stream
config.description: Defaults of the ypy-stream extension. A single element overrides them with `ypy-config='{"stream":{...}}'`.

config.name: stream.pauseOnBackground
config.description: Close the connection while the tab is in the background and open it again, at once and with `Last-Event-ID`, when it is visible. Off by default.

config.name: stream.merge
config.description: Merge consecutive `ypy-patch-elements` events of the same mode (`inner`, `outer`, `append`) and selector that are waiting to be applied: the last `inner` or `outer` wins and `append` payloads join. The page ends the same. On by default.

config.name: stream.frame
config.description: Apply the events of a stream one animation frame apart (at most 100 ms in a hidden tab), so a fast stream, such as the tokens of a model answer, costs one round of DOM work per frame. Off by default.
